title.narrative: Organización comunitaria en defensa del territorio, la vida digna y la paz

description.narrative:
The project "Community Organization in Defense of Territory, Dignified Life and Peace" will be implemented for 39 months in rural and indigenous territories of the Colombian Caribbean: departments of La Guajira, Cesar, Magdalena, Sucre and Bolívar. The objective is to strengthen the organizational, political, environmental and productive capacities of peasant, indigenous and Afro-descendant communities historically affected by the armed conflict, territorial dispossession and structural exclusion.
The project will accompany more than 2,300 women and young people, and 1,150 men, through training, legal, environmental and peacebuilding processes, prioritizing the defense of the territory, climate justice and the empowerment of community leaders. Through the Deache Workshop School, agroecological meetings, participatory documentation, memory actions and advocacy spaces, initiatives for the right to food, community resilience and the transformation of social norms with a gender approach will be consolidated.
